shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6: sky level above, solid rock basement below, fully simulated linked maps with live see-through air, cross-level work and hauling, linked weather, one-colony UI.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: one sky level above, the surface, one basement below. Every level is a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky level with a live view of the surface below; (2) performance via caching, event-driven work, and zero recurring cost when idle.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony only (no Prepatcher, no MultiFloors dependency).
- Cap: 3 levels per column, enforced in LevelMapGen and PlaceWorker_ABStairs.
- Upper-level rules match Z-Levels beta semantics (documented deviations: floor removal only drops on exposed air; bomb rooftop holes deferred).
- Basement: 100% solid mineable rock matching surface geology, fogged, thick-roofed; vanilla collapse rules intact.
- Robustness: ABGuard kill switches; HarmonyBoot per-class patching; fail open everywhere.
- All player-facing text: vanilla sentence case, ASCII only, no long dashes.

## How it works (end of T3.1)
- Core: LevelComp registry on aligned pocket maps; stairs pairs generate levels; StairTransfer moves pawns AND their carried cargo through stairwells (cargo detached before despawn because vanilla job cleanup drops carried things, reattached after respawn; loss-proof fallbacks on every branch); PageUp/PageDown level view.
- Sky mountains: contracted mass, ledge ring, two lit unroofed face rows, fogged thick-roofed core, guaranteed fog reveal on mining.
- See-below renderer: content-only section copies at y=-2.5, air-cells light mask, live dynamic things below, far clip 70.
- Weather link: sky adopts ground weather every 150 ticks.
- Live sync (MapEvents): roof below governs rooftop above; sky floors write roofs below; things over air fall.
- Cross-level work: virtual scan at the stairwell exit; idle return; drafted gizmos; colony-wide Work/Schedule tables.
- Cross-level hauling: storage-driven (better strictly-greater priority on a linked level, vanilla StoreUtility decides) PLUS construction-demand-driven (CrossLevelDemand caches each level's remaining blueprint/frame material needs every 600 ticks; materials flow toward demanding levels, loose delivery at the stairs feeds construct-deliver directly, and demanded materials are pinned to their level so storage hauling cannot export them). One round trip bounded by cache TTL after demand completes. Verdict cache shared across pawns.
- Cross-level needs: bed redirect on linked levels; hunger and recreation via idle-return drift.
- One-colony resources: every column map's ResourceCounter counts all levels.

## Quadruple pass log
T3.1: transfer cargo loss-proof (verified all branches: success, TryStartCarry failure, exception recovery); demand loops impossible (demanding levels never export, TTL bounds post-completion drift). Confidence: cargo transfer 92%, demand hauling 84%, storage hauling 84%, rest redirect 88%, resource counts 90%.
Known gaps: bills do not actively fetch across levels (stockpiles near benches + demand hauling cover the practical cases); patient/medical beds same-level; two-hop redirects fall back gracefully.

## Tranche plan
- T0-T2 DONE. T3.1 CODE DONE (awaiting test).
- T4: systems: temperature sync, power across levels, threat policy, map-removal cleanup, profiling; renderer polish; publishing prep per global rules (field manual, BBCode description, clean folder).

## Status
T3.1 compiled green, pushed. Pending test: cargo carried through stairs both directions, construction on one level pulling materials from another.
